summary: Phase 2 backend + frontend E2E testing complete. 14/14 new backend tests passed (AI script import via Gemini + default provider + invalid provider 400 + member 403; script diff selected_codes creates only chosen scene + idempotent 409 on re-confirm; additive-only skips existing titles; canvas GET auto-creates empty board; PUT increments rev and persists; PUT with stale rev → 409; reviewer canvas.view GET ok / PUT 403; member canvas.write allowed; snapshot create/list/restore with node_count and payload excluded from list; version download via httpOnly access_token cookie works and unauthenticated → 401). Phase 1 regression re-ran (TestVersions all pass with updated cookie assertion). Frontend E2E on Chromium: admin login → DEMO-01 → tab-canvas add scene/character/shot nodes (9 on board) → node-editor with title+text inputs → canvas-save (toast) → canvas-snapshots dialog → snap-name-input + snap-create-btn lists snapshot → canvas-undo/canvas-redo enabled and clicked → tab-script manual textarea + use-ai-checkbox toggles Gemini provider → script-manual-submit calls AI → 2 diff-check-* checkboxes render → uncheck one → script-confirm-btn shows toast 'tạo 1 scene mới' (confirms only checked). Review: opened shot SH-010 sheet, tab-review renders review form (timecode input, add-timecode, textarea, Đạt/Không đạt buttons) — no crash; review-video element not rendered because latest version is application/octet-stream (test payload, not mp4), which is acceptable per task spec.
critical_code_review_comments: scripts.py confirm_staging still always creates a new empty sequence 'SEQ-IMP' when there is at least one to_create; carry-over note from iteration_1: if all scenes are duplicates the code correctly returns early with created_scenes=0 without creating an empty sequence (verified). OK.
canvas.py restore_snapshot returns the full canvas doc including nodes/edges (correct, contrast with list_snapshots which strips them). Good.

canvas.py save_canvas: rev mismatch check via find_one_and_update({project_id, rev}) is correct optimistic concurrency; snapshot restore uses $inc rev — this could invalidate a client's in-flight PUT (409). Documented behavior is fine.
versions.py download_version now reads cookie first, then Bearer, then ?auth — good. Preview-URL cookies are httpOnly + SameSite, so <video src=?auth=..> path remains available.

scripts.py ai_parse_script: prompt asks for JSON array; _extract_json strips ``` fences and trims to first [ ... last ] — reasonable but if model returns single-object it will fail. Consider defensive fallback (wrap dict in list).
AI ai_parse_script does not enforce max input length beyond raw_text[:120000] slice — no rate limit / cost cap. Consider quota per-project.
